en.name: Broccoli rabe
en.summary: Broccoli rabe is a leafy brassica grown for its buds, stems and leaves together, closer to a turnip green than to broccoli and characteristically bitter. Refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below it keeps 3–5 days from the day of purchase, and blanched and frozen it holds good quality for 10–12 months.
en.pantry: Broccoli rabe should not be kept at room temperature. It is mostly leaf and thin stem, so it loses water fast, and the small buds open into yellow flowers within a day in a warm kitchen — at which point the bitterness sharpens considerably. There is no room-temperature figure here and none should be assumed. Refrigerate it unwashed as soon as you get home.
en.fridge: Store broccoli rabe unwashed in a perforated bag in the crisper at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, where it keeps 3–5 days from purchase. Wrap the cut stem ends in kitchen paper and keep the bunch loose rather than crushed, because the buds bruise and blacken where they are pressed. Keep it away from apples and pears, whose ethylene makes the buds open and yellow faster. Do not wash before storing; water trapped among the buds is what turns them slimy.
en.freezer: Broccoli rabe freezes well provided it is blanched — and blanching does double duty here, because it also takes the hardest edge off the bitterness. Trim the stem ends, cut the bunch into manageable lengths, boil for 2 minutes, plunge into iced water, drain and squeeze out the water, then pack airtight at −18 °C (0 °F). It stays safe indefinitely and keeps good quality for 10–12 months.
en.thawing: Add frozen broccoli rabe straight to a hot pan with garlic and oil, or to a soup, without thawing. If a recipe needs it thawed, thaw in the fridge and squeeze it dry first so the pan is not flooded.
spoilage: Buds opened into yellow flowers, then browning
Slimy or blackened leaves and bud clusters
Stems gone limp and bendy instead of snapping
A sour or strongly sulphurous smell
tips: Choose bunches with tight green buds, firm stems and no yellow showing.
Blanch before sautéing to tame the bitterness — this is the standard Italian method, not a shortcut.
Peel the thickest stems if they are woody; the inside is tender.
Do not wash before storing; rinse only when you are ready to cook.

faq.q: How long does broccoli rabe last in the fridge?
faq.a: 3–5 days from the day of purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, unwashed in a perforated bag in the crisper.
Yes. Blanch for 2 minutes, chill, squeeze dry and pack airtight at −18 °C (0 °F) for 10–12 months of good quality.

faq.q: Can you eat broccoli rabe once it has flowered?
faq.a: Yes, if the leaves and stems are still firm — flowering is a quality change, and it will taste more bitter. Discard the bunch if it has gone slimy or smells sour.

faq.q: How do you make broccoli rabe less bitter?
faq.a: Blanch it in well-salted boiling water for a couple of minutes and drain it before you sauté. Salt and a squeeze of lemon at the end help too.

zh.name: 球花甘藍
zh.summary: 球花甘藍是連花苞、莖和葉一起吃的十字花科蔬菜，親緣上比較接近蕪菁葉而不是青花菜，味道明顯偏苦。4°C 以下冷藏，從購買當天算起可放 3～5 天；汆燙後冷凍則可維持 10～12 個月的良好品質。
zh.pantry: 球花甘藍不應該放室溫。它大部分是葉子和細莖，失水非常快；在溫暖的廚房裡，小小的花苞一天就會開成黃花，苦味也會跟著明顯加重。這裡不提供常溫保存天數，也請不要自行推估。買回家請不清洗直接冷藏。
zh.fridge: 不清洗，裝進打洞袋放在 4°C 以下的蔬果保鮮室，從購買日起可放 3～5 天。莖的切口用廚房紙巾包起來，整把鬆鬆放好不要壓實，因為花苞被壓到就會碰傷發黑。另外要遠離蘋果和梨子，它們釋放的乙烯會加速開花泛黃。保存前不要洗；卡在花苞間的水正是變黏的原因。
zh.freezer: 球花甘藍只要先汆燙就很適合冷凍——而且汆燙在這裡一舉兩得，因為它同時能去掉最尖銳的苦味。切掉莖的末端，把整把切成好處理的長度，滾水煮 2 分鐘，泡冰水冷卻，瀝乾並擠掉水分，密封後放 −18°C。安全上可無限期保存，品質可維持 10～12 個月。
zh.thawing: 冷凍球花甘藍可以不解凍，直接下有蒜末和油的熱鍋，或直接丟進湯裡。食譜若需要解凍，請放冷藏室退冰並先擠乾水分，才不會下鍋就滿鍋水。
spoilage: 花苞開成黃花，接著轉褐
葉片和花球變得黏滑或發黑
有酸味或濃重的硫磺味
tips: 挑花苞緊實翠綠、莖結實、沒有泛黃的。
下鍋炒之前先汆燙去苦味，這是義大利的標準做法，不是偷懶。
太粗的莖若纖維老，削掉外皮，裡面其實很嫩。
保存前不要洗，要煮之前再沖。

faq.q: 球花甘藍放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 4°C 以下冷藏，不清洗、裝打洞袋放蔬果室，從購買當天算起 3～5 天。
可以。汆燙 2 分鐘、冰鎮、擠乾後密封放 −18°C，品質可維持 10～12 個月。

faq.q: 已經開花的球花甘藍還能吃嗎？
faq.a: 只要葉和莖還結實就可以，開花屬於品質變化，只是會更苦。若已經黏滑或發酸，整把丟掉。

faq.q: 怎麼讓球花甘藍不要那麼苦？
faq.a: 先用加了足量鹽的滾水汆燙兩分鐘再瀝乾，然後才下鍋炒。起鍋前加點鹽和檸檬汁也有幫助。
